scenes.title: Text-only logo
scenes.narration: FINALTab. One receipt. One clear settlement.

scenes.title: What it does
scenes.narration: Turn a shared receipt into an exact split, gather approvals, move test funds once, and leave public proof.

scenes.title: Use cases
scenes.narration: For dinners, trips, team expenses, or agent-led payments, everyone sees each amount, approval, and result.

scenes.title: How it works
scenes.narration: Vision reads the bill. Math checks every cent. Reviewers check the split and wallet safety. A service runs it. Public test records confirm it.

scenes.title: Real final-site demonstration
scenes.narration: Watch the product: sign in, create a durable tab, enter the receipt workspace, inspect exact-cent reviews, open the evidence graph, and reach the proof route—one traceable path from input to verification.

scenes.title: Complex typed agent task
scenes.narration: Now try a hard request: weighted items, shared service, exclusions, and a payer correction. Typed input stays visible. The model suggests assignments. Math balances every cent. Four reviewers record what passed and why. Memory keeps a compact audit summary.

scenes.title: Authenticated MCP hard stop
scenes.narration: MCP, the tool connection, signs in, lists nine tools, allocates the receipt, prepares wallet details, and asks for approval. Then it stops: no signing, no sending, and no money moves. A read-only check verifies the earlier authorized settlement.

scenes.title: Proof CTA
scenes.narration: FINALTab. People approve. The earlier run executed once. Anyone can verify.
